items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: There was a fellow around here named Piku. White from the barber here. ... he called me up to his barber shop and he showed me a whole lot of this, you know, tech things on the home.

ctx.x: But I never was interested in nothing like none of them. I wanted to blow. I got me a clarinet. I was a clarinet. And nobody learned me nothing about that. I just found all the cards. I mean all the new things I wanted to find myself. But my daddy didn't know nothing about it. And nobody around here. There was a fellow around here named Piku. White from the barber here. Here, after I began to practice and clearly, he called me up to his barber shop and he showed me a whole lot of this, you know, tech things on…
His name was 피Cu Lazana. 피Cu Lazana. 피Cu Lazana. Yeah. He was a barber here.
